title: Approach Modesty Gradually
whyMatters: Modesty is part of Islamic character and worship, but new Muslims often face cultural pressure, family reactions, body concerns, or work constraints. Gradual, sincere growth is healthier than panic.

exactActions.text: Learn the purpose before the wardrobe
subSteps: Modesty includes clothing, speech, gaze, behavior, and dignity.
Do not reduce the whole topic to one garment or one cultural style.
Ask a qualified teacher what applies to your situation.
Choose looser or more covering options you can wear comfortably.
Avoid buying a whole new wardrobe under pressure.
Some people may notice changes and ask questions.
Keep your answer calm and short.
If a change creates danger at home, get local support before moving faster.

timeEstimate: Ongoing, one step at a time

obstacles.problem: People are pressuring me to change everything
obstacles.solution: Pressure is not the same as guidance. Ask a qualified, compassionate teacher for priorities and take sustainable steps.
Learn what is religiously required, then explore practical options. If accommodation is needed, seek local advice and keep the request specific.

tinyVersion: Choose one more modest, comfortable outfit you can pray in.
unlocksNext: A calm approach to modesty supports worship, confidence, and healthy identity.

contextNotes.title: Family safety
contextNotes.body: If visible changes may trigger hostility, talk to a trusted local mentor before making sudden changes.
